subject: GCP billing: split invoice & VAT allocation mismatch (OrbitCloud)
messages:
From: Sabrina Chu <sabrina.chu@orbitcloud.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference.com; marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com
Cc: billing@orbitcloud.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:42:00 -0500
Subject: Discrepancy on GCP Marketplace invoice (split across accounts)

Hi Hannah / Marcus,

We're reconciling our December marketplace bill and noticed a couple of oddities on the GCP Marketplace invoice ORBIT-9987:

- The usage for the production project appears split across two customer IDs (project-a-prod / project-a-billing). The marketplace invoice attributes VAT differently between the two line items, which causes a VAT shortfall on our side.
- The invoice PDF lists a combined gross amount but your marketplace metering record (as provided by GCP) shows usage mapped to two separate partner ledger IDs.

Can you confirm whether Redwood consolidated the meter records for OrbitCloud or if they were sent as separate ledger entries? We need a reconciliation CSV (meter IDs + usage + price per unit) and any marketplace settlement reference to justify the VAT allocation.

I've attached our reconciliation_sheet_ORBIT_2026Q4.csv and a redacted meter dump. Happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Sabrina Chu
Head of Finance, OrbitCloud
S: +44 20 5555 1234

Attachments: reconciliation_sheet_ORBIT_2026Q4.csv, gcp_meter_report_2026-12-31.csv

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference.com
To: Sabrina Chu <sabrina.chu@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com; laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com; neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 12:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on GCP Marketplace invoice (split across accounts)

Hi Sabrina — thanks for flagging this. We pulled the initial billing materials and I wanted to outline next steps so we don't duplicate work: 

1) Marcus (Billing Ops) will pull the raw meter mapping and settlement references from our marketplace connector.
2) Laura (Revenue Operations) will compare the ledger IDs in the invoice vs. the metering export and verify VAT labels.
3) Neha (Tax) will advise on whether this is a VAT misallocation that requires a corrective invoice or a credit note.

Can you confirm the OrbitCloud accounting contact and the EU VAT number you want used for the correction? If you can also share the specific invoice line numbers (on ORBIT-9987) that you believe are misallocated that will speed things up.

I'll follow up once Marcus has the meter mappings.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0210

Attachment: (none)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com
To: Sabrina Chu <sabrina.chu@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference.com; laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:33:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Discrepancy on GCP Marketplace invoice (split across accounts)

Sabrina —

We extracted the marketplace meter mapping and matched it to the settlement file. Two things to call out:

- GCP sent two distinct partner_product_id entries for OrbitCloud: partner-prod-01 and partner-prod-01-b. Those were ingested as separate ledger lines in our partner settlement (hence the split).
- Our pricing ladder applied the same per-unit price to both ledger lines, but VAT tagging in our export defaulted to "non-EU" for one line because the linked customer billing profile was missing the country code in our system. That appears to be a data-mapping issue on our side.

Attached are:
- gcp_meter_report_2026-12-31.csv (meter_id, partner_product_id, usage, unit_price, currency)
- reconciliation_sheet_ORBIT_2026Q4.csv (our matched rows; note column X = marketplace_settlement_ref)

Proposed next steps:
- We can issue a corrective settlement to reclassify the VAT on the affected line and apply a credit for the VAT difference.
- Alternatively, if OrbitCloud prefers, we can provide a detailed settlement export and you can route a request through GCP for an invoice amendment.

Which do you prefer? If you want a quick call, I can do 11:00–12:00 ET today.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: gcp_meter_report_2026-12-31.csv, reconciliation_sheet_ORBIT_2026Q4.csv

From: Sabrina Chu <sabrina.chu@orbitcloud.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com; hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference.com
Cc: billing@orbitcloud.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:01:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on GCP Marketplace invoice (split across accounts)

Marcus / Hannah,

Thanks for the quick investigation and the CSVs — that explains the split. OrbitCloud would prefer Redwood to issue the corrective settlement and apply a VAT credit to ORBIT-9987; routing back through GCP will be slower and likely require more hoops.

Our accounting contact is:
- Marta Klein <marta.klein@orbitcloud.com>
EU VAT: GB123456789
Invoice line references: 4 and 7 (see ORBIT-9987 PDF).

Please proceed with the corrective settlement and let us know the expected timeline. We'll accept a credit note against the next payout if that simplifies reconciliation.

Best,
Sabrina

Attachment: invoice_ORBIT-9987.pdf (redacted)"

From: laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com
To: Sabrina Chu <sabrina.chu@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference.com; marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com; neha_kapoor@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:20:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Discrepancy on GCP Marketplace invoice (split across accounts)

Hi Sabrina — appreciate the prompt reply and confirmation.

We will:
- Create a corrective settlement referencing marketplace_settlement_ref S-2026-ORBIT-412 and generate a credit note for the VAT difference.
- Send the credit note and settlement export to both you and Marta by EOD Wednesday (2027-01-20).
- Copy the credit to your next payout OR, if you prefer, issue a standalone refund. Please confirm your preference; otherwise we'll default to credit against the next payout.

Neha — can you confirm the VAT calculation and sign off on the credit amount once Marcus and I send the final numbers?

Sabrina — we'll include a CSV mapping meter_id -> invoice_line for your ledger. Thanks for sending the invoice line references — that helped speed the match.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: (settlement/export will follow)
